notes.title: THUNDER STEAM AWARD KO!
notes.content: Thunder is gearing up for the ultimate showdown at the Steam Awards! Our goal? To deliver a knockout performance that leaves every other game in the dust. Your vote can make the difference and help us secure that gorgeous digital trophy!

notes.title: SURVIVAL MODE
notes.content:
Getting even better! We're thrilled to announce that we've added the much-anticipated 'survival mode,' promising an even more challenging and exciting experience. What's more, we've optimized the game to run at a blazing 60 fps, ensuring smooth and seamless gameplay.

But that's not all: we've listened to the community, and we're excited to announce full DualSense support. Feel the immersion in every punch and move like never before!

All of this and more is now available on Steam, ready to take your gaming experience to the next level. So, what are you waiting for? Get ready for a weekend packed with action and adrenaline! 💥🎮 #GamingWeekend #SteamRelease

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility ✅
notes.content:
[h1]Thunder Ray is fully playable on Steam Deck![/h1]

While we wait for the official verification from Valve, we want to announce that the game is 100% compatible:

[list]
[*] Steam Deck screen resolution supported
[*] Steam Deck controls supported
[*] No framerate glitches
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42321221/a9ca5ebcd0b14cba253c4fbfcbae918825804a6e.png[/img]

notes.content:

notes.title: Thunder Ray - Next Festival II
notes.content:

It will be the first time that we will show the game to the world after 1 year of hard work.
Don´t lose this opportunity to see all the game features:

- Handmade animations
- Superfast fighting gameplay
- Cool and unique Enemies
- Super attacks
- 12 characters to defeat
- 12locations
- Original Soundtrack

Echito our Lead game designer will be your host on this amazing stream!
